contamination_risks: The exact 2020-2021 basket date-symbol pairs are globally untouched at freeze.
Warmup prices are feature-only contaminated inputs and cannot count as promotion evidence.
The basket, grid, ranking, and partitions are frozen before provider access.
Confirmation remains inaccessible until one exact inspected winner is frozen.
family_contract.entry_rule: Require at least four or five completed basket declines and a median basket loss of at least 0.5% or 1.0%; rank targets down at least 1.0% or 1.5% by worst return and enter next open.
family_contract.exit_rule: Resolve stop first on daily ambiguity and otherwise exit at the completed close after two or five sessions.
family_contract.expected_holding_behavior: Long only, next-session-open entry, and flat within five sessions.
falsifiers: breadth selloffs do not produce a stable rebound
family_contract.material_difference_rationale: This mechanism requires synchronous market breadth capitulation across six broad-equity ETFs, unlike single-instrument oversold, trend-pullback, cross-sectional reversal, or Treasury-confirmed risk-off rules.
family_contract.mechanism: Treat a completed, broad one-session selloff across a frozen basket of highly liquid U.S. equity ETFs as forced risk liquidation; buy only the worst qualifying constituent at the next session open for a bounded rebound.
family_contract.primary_outcome: Selection-adjusted chronological account log growth after costs.
production_compatibility_risks: Fresh quote, spread, depth, halt, tradability, timestamp, GTC protection, and before-open reconciliation remain mandatory.
family_contract.ranking_rule: Worst completed one-session return, then canonical symbol.
family_contract.selection_rule: At most one new family entry per day under all portfolio risk, notional, daily-entry, and capital-contention caps.
family_contract.stop_rule: Use one or one-and-a-half completed ATR14 below entry; missing or structurally invalid protection is a missed trade.

universe_requirements.selection_basis: Six liquid broad U.S. equity ETFs frozen before price access; their exact 2020-2021 pairs are globally outcome-clean.
